attractions.name: Duquesne Incline
attractions.description: Historic incline railway and skyline views from Mount Washington.

attractions.name: Mount Washington Grandview Overlook
attractions.description: Panoramic views of downtown Pittsburgh, the three rivers and bridges from Grandview Avenue.

attractions.name: Monongahela Incline
attractions.description: Historic incline connecting Station Square with Mount Washington.

attractions.name: Point State Park
attractions.description: Downtown park at the meeting of the Allegheny and Monongahela rivers, with a landmark fountain.

attractions.name: PNC Park
attractions.description: Baseball stadium with a celebrated view of the Pittsburgh skyline.

attractions.name: Strip District
attractions.description: Historic market district with food shops, restaurants and specialty retailers.

attractions.name: Kamin Science Center
attractions.description: Hands-on science exhibits on Pittsburgh's North Shore; formerly Carnegie Science Center.

attractions.name: Senator John Heinz History Center
attractions.description: Regional history museum in the Strip District.

attractions.name: The Andy Warhol Museum
attractions.description: Museum dedicated to Pittsburgh-born artist Andy Warhol.

attractions.name: Phipps Conservatory and Botanical Gardens
attractions.description: Botanical gardens and historic glasshouse in Schenley Park.

attractions.name: Carnegie Museum of Natural History
attractions.description: Natural history museum in Oakland known for its dinosaur collections.

attractions.name: Carnegie Museum of Art
attractions.description: Art museum in Pittsburgh's Oakland neighborhood.

attractions.name: Cathedral of Learning
attractions.description: University of Pittsburgh landmark known for its Gothic Revival architecture and Nationality Rooms.

attractions.name: National Aviary
attractions.description: Bird-focused attraction in Allegheny Commons Park.

attractions.name: Roberto Clemente Bridge
attractions.description: Iconic downtown-to-North-Shore bridge near PNC Park.

attractions.name: Fort Pitt Museum
attractions.description: Museum interpreting Pittsburgh's frontier and early history at Point State Park.

attractions.name: Heinz Memorial Chapel
attractions.description: Gothic Revival chapel on the University of Pittsburgh campus.

attractions.name: Schenley Park
attractions.description: Large urban park with trails and green spaces near Oakland.

attractions.name: Frick Pittsburgh
attractions.description: Art and history destination on the former Frick family estate.

attractions.name: Randyland
attractions.description: Colorful outdoor art environment in Pittsburgh's North Side.
